methods.name: create
methods.summary: Generate a new custom Certificate Signing Request (CSR) for an account or zone.
methods.description:
Generate a new custom Certificate Signing Request (CSR) for an account or zone.
Cloudflare generates and securely stores the private key associated with the
CSR.

props.name: common_name
props.description: The common name (domain) for the CSR. Must be at most 64 characters.

props.name: country
props.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

props.name: locality
props.description: City or locality name.

props.name: organization
props.description: Organization name.

props.name: sans
props.description: Subject Alternative Names for the CSR. At least one SAN is required.

props.name: state
props.description: State or province name.

props.name: account_id
props.description:
The Account ID to use for this endpoint. Mutually exclusive with the
Zone ID.

props.name: zone_id
props.description:
The Zone ID to use for this endpoint. Mutually exclusive with the
Account ID.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional description for the CSR.

props.name: key_type
props.description:
Key algorithm to use for the CSR. Defaults to rsa2048 if not
specified.

props.name: name
props.description: Human-readable name for the CSR.

props.name: organizational_unit
props.description: Organizational unit name.

props.name: account_id

props.name: zone_id

props.name: order
props.description: The field to sort the returned custom CSRs by.
